name: Oride Amane
source:
“Come on, talk to me. I may not look it, but I'm a great listener.”

A sports-loving girl who relies heavily on intuition.

She devotes herself earnestly to track and field and consistently earns strong results. Due to her unusual sensibilities, she is regarded as an eccentric.

Once she believes in something, she acts immediately and never wavers from her convictions.

Class: Physical Type
Reality-Altering Ability: Oracle — an ability that lets her read one move ahead and predict the optimal course of action. Paired with heightened physical prowess, the ability is specialized for close-quarters combat.
